weil.label: weil
weil.rule: weil (because) gives the REASON and sends the verb to the END of its clause: Ich bleibe zu Hause, weil es regnet. If the weil-clause comes first, the main clause starts with its verb: Weil es regnet, bleibe ich zu Hause.

obwohl.label: obwohl
obwohl.rule: obwohl (although) introduces an OBSTACLE and sends the verb to the END of its clause: Ich gehe spazieren, obwohl es regnet. If the obwohl-clause comes first, the main clause starts with its verb: Obwohl es regnet, gehe ich spazieren.

deshalb.label: deshalb
deshalb.rule: deshalb (therefore) points to the RESULT. It takes position 1 of its clause, so the verb comes right after it (position 2): Es regnet, deshalb bleibe ich zu Hause.

trotzdem.label: trotzdem
trotzdem.rule: trotzdem (nevertheless) shows what happens anyway. It takes position 1 of its clause, so the verb comes right after it (position 2): Es regnet, trotzdem gehe ich spazieren.
